reviews.title: Nice Z890 Motherboard
reviews.comment: Nice board, it is a bit nicer overall than the previous Z690 Unify-X and has more features than the comparable Gigabyte and Asus models. Bios is easy to use and it works great with my 285K and G.Skill 8800MT/S CU-DIMMs.  It is surprising that it has 6 M.2 slots even more than some mainstream boards which is interesting since it is an OC focused board.
reviews.author: Jeff

reviews.title: Solid Mid-High Tier Motherboard with a clean aesthetic.
reviews.comment: This motherboard has a clean design. Minimal RGB and great hardware to get as much as you can out of the Intel Core Ultra CPUs!
reviews.author: Bradley S

reviews.title: Awesome features, horrible instructions and couldn't get unit online without a bios update first.
reviews.comment: When you buy an expensive motherboard, please include at least a diagram of the connections on the motherboard and don't make me grab my iPad to have to look it up online.  And I almost returned this Motherboard because after installing Windows 11 I couldn't get connected wired or wireless.  I thought it was broke, but it just needed the bios updated.  Not a way to build customer loyalty.  Next build I am going back to Gigabyte and Corsair.
reviews.author: Tom D
